verdictVocabulary.FAIL: the baseline runs the scenario and the oracle rejects it
verdictVocabulary.NOT_RUNNABLE: the baseline lacks the entry control, so the scenario fails at setup
verdictVocabulary.PASS: regression guard; holds at the baseline, non-triviality proven by its control or mutant

rule: The baseline check runs each S1 scenario command against the baseline worktree (candidate tests overlaid) and compares the result with baselineVerdict: PASS expects a passing test, FAIL and NOT_RUNNABLE expect a failing test. Any mismatch rejects the runner and step definitions; negative controls are not run against the baseline.
source: uiux-system-model-live-default design "S1 scenario set" and the per-change fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json files

scenarios.title: The operator switches the system default without restarting
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: frontend/src/features/providers/ui/providers-page.tsx:409-410 offers only a per-provider 'Set as default' button; there is no System default model picker or provider/model pair control to drive, and the baseline PUT-then-POST sequence has no console entry (providers-store.ts:156-176 posts the route only). Round-1 revision: the target model differs from bdd-provider-b's default_model (claude-5-sonn

scenarios.title: An agent with its own model keeps it and is listed when the default changes
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: No pinned-agent list or system default change result exists in the baseline console (frontend/src/features/agents/ui/agents-page.tsx classifies status only at :206-225), and the picker entry is absent.

scenarios.title: Changing the default uses only the live route
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: The console write set to compare needs the picker action (absent, providers-page.tsx:409-410). The control also fails at baseline: the settings API accepts llm.default_provider (src/uar/settings/manager.rs:1247-1249 and set_value at :666-671), whereas the oracle requires a 4xx rejection.

scenarios.title: A conversation override keeps answering on its own model
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: The scenario's operator step drives the new system default picker, which the baseline lacks (frontend/src/features/providers/ui/providers-page.tsx:409-410 offers only the per-provider button); every scenario using that step is NOT_RUNNABLE at baseline.

scenarios.title: Clearing an override shows what the conversation will inherit
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: The scenario uses only baseline-runnable steps (default set through the existing route by a harness step, override chosen in the sheet, clear control present). Clearing sets an empty value with no preview (frontend/src/features/chat/session-config-panel.tsx:75-86), so the oracle's preview is absent. It needs no new stub kind.

scenarios.title: Changing one conversation leaves the others alone
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: The final step changes the default through the picker, absent at baseline (providers-page.tsx:409-410), and the scenario's confirm and clear steps need the preview flow; the round-1 PASS expectation is withdrawn.

scenarios.title: A reply already being written finishes on the model it started with
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: Needs the hold_content stub kind, GET /_stub/held and POST /_stub/release, absent from the pre-phase stub (src/bin/stub-llm.rs accepts only content, grounded_content and tool_call and panics on others); the capability probe GET /_stub/capabilities does not exist there, so setup fails. It also uses the picker step.

scenarios.title: A conversation without an override follows the new default and says so
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: Uses the picker operator step (absent at baseline) and a receipt that does not exist; additionally PolicyScope has no system-default origin (src/uar/domain/policy.rs:346-357).

scenarios.title: A choice that cannot be served is refused and nothing is claimed
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: Scenario 7 begins with the operator trying to change the default through the picker, absent at baseline (providers-page.tsx:409-410). The route half would fail at baseline (src/uar/api/providers.rs:367-399 accepts a disabled provider) but is not reached by a baseline-runnable step.

scenarios.title: The receipt names the model the provider reported, not the one requested
scenarios.basis: fixtures/baseline-verdicts.json: Needs the served_model stub kind and GET /_stub/capabilities, absent from the pre-phase stub (src/bin/stub-llm.rs), and a receipt that does not exist.
